name: UQ Union Food Co-Op
summary: Free and low-cost grocery pantry for UQ students at St Lucia, open to free Mates Rates members.
key: Food Co-Op is a pantry for UQ students to stock up on a range of free and low-cost grocery items.
who: UQ students with a Mates Rates membership, which is free.
how: Visit the ground floor of the Union Complex, St Lucia, opposite the pharmacy, Monday to Friday, 9am to 3pm.
catches: Staples include cereal, pasta, rice, lentils and peanut butter.

evidence.quote: Food Co-Op is a pantry for UQ students to stock up on a range of free and low-cost grocery items.
this is available exclusively to Mates Rates members.
